content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Ogden

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review your academic background and hours spent leading or directing projects. Granite PM Academy's team can help you assess whether your profile qualifies before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Attend Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our structured curriculum covers the PMBOK Guide framework and exam domains. You'll earn the required formal education hours necessary to apply for the PMP exam through PMI.

steps_items.heading: Submit Application & Fee to PMI
steps_items.text: After boot camp, complete your PMI application online and submit documentation of your education and experience. Pay the PMI examination fee directly to the Project Management Institute. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the submission process to ensure accuracy.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and study guides, to reinforce your knowledge. Schedule your PMP exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Our instructors remain available to answer questions as you finalize your readiness.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, maintain your PMP by earning professional development units during PMI's standard renewal cycle. Stay current with industry best practices and pursue advanced training. Granite PM Academy offers continuing education to support your long-term credential maintenance and career growth.
